title: The Degree of Alignment between Circumbinary Disks and Their Binary Hosts
question: How well aligned are circumbinary disks with their host binaries, particularly for short-period double-lined spectroscopic binaries, and what does this imply for circumbinary planets?

what.value: UZ Tau E disk inclination 56.15 ± 1.50 deg and Omega_disk 90.39 ± 1.50 deg from ALMA continuum; inclination fixed in the dynamical model

evidence.quote: They also measured the disk inclination (relative to the sky plane) to be $i_\mathrm{disk} = 56.15 \ensuremath{^\circ} \pm 1.50\ensuremath{^\circ}$

what.value: M_tot sin^3 i_star = 0.69 ± 0.13 Msun and mass ratio q = 0.30 ± 0.03 for UZ Tau E

evidence.loc: 2.3 UZ Tau E 13CO and C18O dynamical analysis
evidence.quote: For UZ Tau E, (cite: jensen07) find $M_\mathrm{tot} \sin^3 i_\star = 0.69 \pm 0.13\,M_\odot$

what.value: Orbital and disk parameters of the circumbinary disk sample compiled in Tables 3-5

evidence.quote: The first group contains the circumbinary systems that have precise measurements of the disk and stellar orientations (Table [3](#tab:disks-known))

external_data.citation: literature references listed in Table 3-5 notes

recipe.method: Self-calibrate on continuum, image with multiscale-multifrequency clean, fit elliptical Gaussian with uvmodelfit

recipe.goal: Line imaging, systemic velocity, cloud-contaminated channels
recipe.method: tclean cubes, moment-0 maps, identify cloud contamination using FCRAO CO 1-0 maps; mask 4.0-7.5 km/s LSRK

recipe.goal: Dynamical mass of UZ Tau E
recipe.method: Forward-model 13CO and C18O emission to visibilities with a parametric disk (RADMC-3D), complex chi2 likelihood, MCMC
key_parameters: q fixed to 0.5; i_disk fixed to 56.15 deg; gamma=1; d=131.2 pc
assumptions: Keplerian rotation, vertically isothermal, hydrostatic equilibrium, distance 131.2 pc

recipe.method: Combine disk-based M_tot with RV M_tot sin^3 i_star from Jensen et al. 2007

recipe.goal: Hierarchical Bayesian inference of mutual inclination distribution
recipe.method: Logit-normal p(theta) with hyperparameters mu_v, tau_v; disk-frame rotation; sample full posterior of 4 SB2 disks (V4046 Sgr, DQ Tau, UZ Tau E, AK Sco) using cos i_disk and cos i_star
key_parameters: hyperpriors: mu_v ~ N(0,2); tau_v half-Gaussian (mu=0.5, sigma=4) with tau>0.5
assumptions: AK Sco astrometric orbit ignored; Omega_star treated as unknown; uniform phi
